description: This is a shell script file (t0027-auto-crlf.sh) containing a comprehensive test suite for git's line ending normalization behavior, involving creation of test files with different line endings, attributes, and git configurations. It includes functions for creating test files, setting git attributes, performing commits, and verifying file contents and warnings related to line ending conversions.

methods.name: compare_files
methods.description: Compares two files after transforming line endings to check for equivalence, considering CRLF and other line endings.

methods.name: compare_ws_file
methods.description: Compares two files with additional processing to mask line ending differences and specific control characters.

methods.name: create_gitattributes
methods.description: Creates a .gitattributes file with specified attributes for testing line ending normalization.

methods.name: create_NNO_MIX_files
methods.description: Creates test files with not-normalized (NNO) and mixed line endings for testing.

methods.name: check_warning
methods.description: Checks for specific warning messages about line ending conversions and compares expected versus actual warnings.

methods.name: commit_check_warn
methods.description: Performs commits with specific attributes and configurations, checks for expected warnings.

methods.name: commit_chk_wrnNNO
methods.description: Sets up test files, commits, and verifies warnings for not-normalized line ending files with various attributes.

methods.name: commit_MIX_chkwrn
methods.description: Sets up test files with mixed line endings, commits, and verifies warnings.

methods.name: stats_ascii
methods.description: Returns a string representing the line ending style for reporting purposes.

methods.name: attr_ascii
methods.description: Converts text attribute settings into human-readable strings for display.

methods.name: check_files_in_repo
methods.description: Verifies that files in the repository match expected contents for different line ending configurations.

methods.name: check_in_repo_NNO
methods.description: Verifies in-repository consistency of line ending files for various attributes.

methods.name: checkout_files
methods.description: Tests checkout behavior with various configurations, line endings, and attributes.
